_doc: HUD messages for the social actions. Wrestle/play lines are the opponent's ({first} = you); pray/mass/confess are narration or the priest's words.

win: {Self} lies winded in the grass. "Fair fall. Best of three?"
You pin {self}, and the onlookers cheer.
"Ow! You've a grip like a smith's, {first}." {Self} grins.
A good throw. {Self} gets up laughing and dusts down.
{Self} slaps the ground in surrender. "Enough, enough!"
"Where did you learn that?" {Self} rubs a bruised shoulder.
You twist {self}'s arm up behind, and they yield with a laugh.
A hard struggle. At the end {self} lies panting beneath you.
"Where did you get your strength?" {Self} pants.
lose: {Self} throws you flat. "Down you go. Best of three?"
You're pinned. {Self} sits on you until you yield.
"Not bad," says {self}, "but not good enough." You taste dirt.
{Self} laughs and offers a hand up. You take it, ruefully.
The onlookers jeer kindly as you are flung down.
"Next time, {first}!" {Self} grins, not even out of breath.
{Self} proves too strong; you land hard and laugh.
It was close. In the end, {self} wins.
You are bested, but not shamed, and {self} says as much.

play: You and {self} race about the green until you're out of breath.
A game of tag leaves you both breathless and laughing.
You chase {self} round the well, then round it again.
A rowdy hour of hoops and hide-and-seek.
You play with {self} till the light begins to fade.
A game of hoodman blind, much shrieking.
You and {self} play at skittles until the light fades.
You and {self} chase hoops down the lane.
pray: You kneel on the cold stones and say a Paternoster.
You bow your head and pray for your kin.
For a few quiet minutes the cares of the day fall away.
You say an Ave and cross yourself.
You pray for rain, or for sun, as the season wants.
You light a candle and say what is on your heart.
You pray in silence, and are glad of it.
You whisper the Hail Mary and cross yourself.
mass: You hear Mass with the parish; the incense hangs blue in the light.
The Latin rolls over you as it has over your fathers.
You kneel with your neighbours; the priest lifts the Host and the bell rings.
Mass is long and the bench is hard, but you leave quieter in heart.
You sing the responses, off-key, with everyone else.

mass.t: The priest nods to you as you leave.
The monks' chant rises and falls under the great roof.

mass: You answer "Amen" with all the rest.
The sanctus bell rings and the whole church kneels.

confess.t: {Self} hears you out and sets a penance: three Paternosters and a day of fasting.
"Go and sin no more, my {addr}." {Self} makes the sign of the cross.
{Self} listens gravely, then absolves you. The weight lifts.
"I have heard few confessions so light," says {self} with a small smile.
{Self} hears you with patience and sets a gentle penance.
{Self} hears you, absolves you, and sends you home lighter.
A short confession; {self} nods and gives a small penance.
